notes.title: Demo patch 1.1.8
notes.notes: [p]Changes:[/p][p]- torment does not spread to enemies when "spreading corruption" perk is active.[/p][p]I like breaking the game with such combos, but picking one perk and one spell to deal with a whole wave is too easy. You'll have to think harder ;)[/p][p] Fixed:[/p][p]- Issues with doubling perk effects when brewing spells - Issues with showing proper buff/debuff icons on enemies[/p]

notes.title: DEMO CONTENT UPDATE - "The Brewing"
notes.notes:
[h1]Fellow decapitators of the King's loyalists! The brewing update is here, and with it:[/h1][p][/p][h2]The spell brewing mechanic[/h2][list][*][p]Craft your spells using your trusty chicken-legged cauldron![/p][/*][*][p]Spell brewing [b]upgrades one of your spells[/b] - you may select any already-owned spell as a base and add up to 2 ingredients to increase its power![/p][/*][*][p]Each ingredient has a positive and a negative effect, e.g. "add armor piercing BUT reduce damage" or "Add bleed BUT make enemies faster". Think wisely when choosing your formula![/p][/*][*][p]You may encounter cauldron nodes on the map that will reward you with spell brewing after the battle.[/p][/*][*][p]You can create really interesting combinations of different effects, but also fall into some traps with anti-synergies. [i]Curious is the spell-maker craft.[/i] Have fun![/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Redesigned map nodes[/b][/h2][list][*][p]As a reward you can now have: a new spell, a spell upgrade, healing, more mana, a new perk[/p][/*][*][p]Instead of a general mana-boosting reward (+2 mana of choice), these nodes now are tied to a specific mana bar. Hatred nodes will allow you to pick +2 hatred OR +1 sorrow or spite. Sorrow nodes will give you +2 sorrow or +1 of hatred or spite, etc. Such a small change brings quite a lot into the decision making process. Choose your paths wisely![/p][/*][*][p]Map rewards are also structured in such a way that you are most likely to get different rewards (spell or mana) at subsequent encounters (with occasional brewing or healing mixed in).[/p][/*][*][p]Oh! And now you start with a bit less mana. That should compensate lesser mana rewards. [i]he hee heeee[/i][/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Redesigned mechanics[/b] [/h2][list][*][p]It mostly boils down to the fact that buffs and debuffs [b]NO LONGER STACK[/b] for most of their effects (the exception is e.g. Torment: deal direct damage on hit)[/p][/*][*][p]This change encourages you to spread your power across the board for better efficiency[/p][/*][*][p]It also favors using different spells instead of the same one on the same enemy over and over again.[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]QoL and visual improvements[/b] [/h2][list][*][p]Tutorial got revamped: until you reach a certain stage, you'll start with a predefined loadout (3 spells and a perk). This allows you to start playing faster, get to know different mechanics with a balanced build, fail and start anew with a standard "pick 3 spells at the run start" routine.[/p][/*][*][p]Added fancy targeting arrow. Now everyone knows which spell is selected.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a map legend so you're not as confused as before.[/p][/*][*][p]Added icons for different spell effects so descriptions are not as wordy.[/p][/*][*][p]Each effect icon has it's tooltip, but these show up only during the brewing screen at the moment. I plan to add them to the main battle screen as well.[/p][/*][*][p]Pretty sure I did add some other things but already forgot which ones...[/p][/*][*][p]Oh! The grass in the background and on the foreground moves with the wind! And leaves fall from the trees. HOW COOL IS THAT?![/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Future plans[/b][/h2][list][*][p]We are planning one more large content update for the demo. It will focus on adding the boss encounter at the end of Act One.[/p][/*][*][p]After that, full steam goes into creating more content in preparation for the 1.0 release: more spells, more enemies, more perks, more fun![/p][/*][/list][h1]Have fun and let us know what you think about these changes! We're looking forward to your comments![/h1][p]Feel free to leave them here, or visit our Discord! Let's chat about your ideas for improvements! :)
[url="https://discord.gg/ZHhEEpvZ"]https://discord.gg/ZHhEEpvZ[/url][/p]
